benchmark.authorship: Independently authored held-out tasks for vuejs/core; task evidence and stop criteria were fixed before writing recorded planner responses

metricNotes: Required evidence recall uses the case's independent requiredFindings descriptors as its denominator.
Relevant evidence precision uses source-related finding records on a statically labeled relevant path divided by all source-related finding records.
Known uncertainty recall uses the case's knownUncertainty checks as its denominator; empty denominators are reported as null.
Unsupported-claim checks use fixture-authored forbidden-claim labels and source finding paths outside the fixture inventory; hypotheses are separately checked for explicit unverified labeling.
Token usage reported by a provider is unavailable in recorded-mock mode; planner budget token usage is an estimate.
Wall-clock durations are omitted from offline saved results so repeated runs remain stable.
